title: Evolutionary AI Control: Population-Level Safety Under Reproduction, Heredity, and Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.31312v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An AI agent can satisfy every individual safety check and still give rise to a population that violates a collective safety limit. This risk arises in open multi-agent systems, where agents copy themselves, modify their successors, and change system membership during a run. Selection then shifts the population toward traits outside the developers' optimization targets. We prove conditions under which safety guarantees persist through reproduction, inheritance, and selection, and we characterize how they fail.   Four counterexamples illustrate these failures. Unauthorized copies, which violate a specified reproductive restriction, can each leave fewer than one successor on average while their expected number grows without bound under continued production from an expanding authorized population. Two lineages can each decline in isolation yet grow exponentially when they interact. Alternating between reproductive rules can drive growth ev

translated_title: 进化式AI控制：繁殖、遗传与选择下的种群级安全
translated_abstract: 一个AI智能体可以满足每一项个体安全检查，却仍然产生出一个违反集体安全限制的种群。这种风险出现在开放的多智能体系统中：在系统运行期间，智能体会复制自身、修改其后继者，并改变系统的成员构成。随后，选择会使种群偏向开发者优化目标之外的性状。我们证明了安全保证能够通过繁殖、遗传和选择而持续存在的条件，并刻画了这些保证失效的方式。四个反例说明了这些失效情形：违反指定繁殖限制的未授权副本，虽然每个个体平均留下的后继者不足一个，但在不断扩张的授权种群的持续生产下，其期望数量却无界增长；两个谱系各自单独存在时均会衰减，却在相互作用时呈指数级增长；在繁殖规则之间交替切换可以驱动增长……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对开放多智能体系统证明了安全保证在繁殖、遗传与选择过程中得以持续存在的条件，并通过四个反例揭示：即使每个智能体都满足个体安全检查，其演化出的种群仍可能突破集体安全限制。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes conditions under which safety guarantees persist through reproduction, heredity, and selection in open multi-agent systems, and demonstrates via four counterexamples that even individually-safe agents can evolve populations violating collective safety limits.
